command: $logFile = 'D:\zebbingo\tools\claude-bridge\deploy_doorbell.log'; function log($m) { $ts = Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm:ss'; "$ts $m" | Out-File -Append $logFile; Write-Output "$ts $m" }; log '=== Starting vsock doorbell deployment ==='; $bridgeDir = 'D:\zebbingo\tools\claude-bridge'; $vhdPath = 'D:\vm_bundles\claudevm.bundle\rootfs.vhdx'; $daemonSrc = Join-Path $bridgeDir 'vsock_doorbell_daemon.py'; $svcSrc = Join-Path $bridgeDir 'vsock-doorbell.service'; log 'Step 1: Verify files'; if (-not (Test-Path $daemonSrc)) { log "ERROR: missing $daemonSrc"; exit 1 }; if (-not (Test-Path $svcSrc)) { log "ERROR: missing $svcSrc"; exit 1 }; log 'Files verified OK'; log 'Step 2: Stop VM'; taskkill /f /im cowork-svc.exe 2>$null; $i=0; while ((Get-Process cowork-svc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $i -lt 10) { Start-Sleep 1; $i++ }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; log 'VM stopped'; log 'Step 3: Mount VHDX via WSL'; $wslOut = wsl --mount $vhdPath --vhd 2>&1; log "WSL mount: $wslOut"; Start-Sleep 3; $mountPath = (wsl bash -c 'ls -d /mnt/wsl/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1' 2>&1).Trim(); if (-not $mountPath) { log 'ERROR: Could not find WSL mount point. Restarting VM...'; sc start CoworkVMService 2>$null; exit 1 }; log "Found mount: $mountPath"; log 'Step 4: Deploy daemon and service'; $deployScript = "cp $daemonSrc.Replace('\','/') $mountPath/tmp/vsock_doorbell_daemon.py 2>&1; chmod +x $mountPath/tmp/vsock_doorbell_daemon.py 2>&1; cp $svcSrc.Replace('\','/') $mountPath/etc/systemd/system/vsock-doorbell.service 2>&1; ln -sf /etc/systemd/system/vsock-doorbell.service $mountPath/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/vsock-doorbell.service 2>&1; echo 'deployed'"; $deployResult = wsl bash -c $deployScript 2>&1; log "Deploy: $deployResult"; log 'Step 5: Unmount VHDX'; wsl --unmount $vhdPath 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2; log 'Unmounted'; log 'Step 6: Restart VM'; sc start CoworkVMService 2>$null; log 'VM restart triggered'; log '=== Deployment finished ==='
